faqs.q: How do I buy a product?
faqs.a: Create an account, log in, go to the product page, and click 'Buy'.

faqs.q: How can I return an item?
faqs.a: Check the seller's return policy on the product page and contact support if needed.

faqs.q: How can I register as a seller?
faqs.a: Go to Sign Up → choose 'Seller' as account type and complete your profile.

faqs.q: How do I list a product?
faqs.a: After login, go to Dashboard → Add Product, fill details, upload images, and publish.
